messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Double hierarchical linear models
parts:
Check out the manual chapter on regression. It shows
how to build hierarchical and multilevel models and suggests
priors for varying-slope and varying-intercept models (assuming
that's what you mean by "mean level" and "variation").

- Bob
